atsusaka_2024_alaska_rcv_survey.office: U.S. House and U.S. Senate, Alaska, 8 November 2022 (hypothetical ballots; tasks 1-2 House, 3-4 Senate; tasks 2 and 4 required a full ranking)

atsusaka_2024_oakland_rcv_survey.office: Oakland mayor, 8 November 2022 (hypothetical ballots; task 2 required a full ranking)

atsusaka_2025_ranking_questions.office: 18 survey ranking questions, 3 to 6 options each (anchor, substantive, wording-arm and repeat questions)

bakker_2021_childrearing_values.office: GSS 2006 panel, Stenner child-rearing values: five qualities ranked 1 (most important) to 5; three waves stacked, one row per respondent x wave (cov_treat is the wave, cov_wave its label)

boudreau_2019_police_blame.office: full 1-7 ranking of the actors most to blame for the 2018 Stephon Clark shooting, in a three-arm information-framing experiment (cov_treat: 0 control, 1 pattern framing, 2 reform framing)

corstange_2022_syria_factions_2015.office: top-3 sympathy ranking of six civil-war factions, wave 1 (2015) of a survey of displaced Syrians; unranked factions are NA (cov_treat: 0 control, 1-3 framing arms)

corstange_2022_syria_factions_2017.office: top-3 sympathy ranking of six civil-war factions, wave 2 (2017); questionnaire item numbering differs from the 2015 wave, so the cov_q* codes are not comparable across the two tables

debian_2006_gr_firmware.office: General Resolution: Handling source-less firmware in the Linux kernel

debian_2006_gr_gfdl.office: General Resolution: Why the GNU Free Documentation License is not suitable for Debian main

debian_2006_gr_reaffirm_dpl.office: General Resolution: Re-affirm support to the Debian Project Leader

debian_2007_gr_election_length.office: Constitutional amendment: reduce the length of DPL election process

debian_2008_gr_lenny_dfsg.office: General Resolution: Lenny and resolving DFSG violations

debian_2014_gr_tc_terms.office: General Resolution: Limiting the term of the technical committee members

debian_2019_gr_init_systems.office: General Resolution: Init systems and systemd

debian_2021_gr_fsf_statement.office: General Resolution: Statement regarding Richard Stallman's readmission to the FSF board

debian_2021_gr_resolution_proc.office: General Resolution: Change the resolution process

debian_2023_gr_cra_pld.office: General Resolution: Statement about the EU Legislation "Cyber Resilience Act and Product Liability Directive"

debian_2026_gr_llm_usage.office: General Resolution: LLM usage in Debian

farvaque_2007_faches_irv.jurisdiction: Faches-Thumesnil, France (voting experiment at two polling stations)
farvaque_2007_faches_irv.office: President of France, first round, 22 April 2007 (experimental instant-runoff ballot offered to voters leaving the polling station; 12 official candidates)

fielding_2018_party_ranking.office: an imaginary alternative-vote ballot in the 2010 British Election Study, seven parties ranked. ONLY the UKIP and BNP positions are in the released extract; the other five parties are NA for every respondent because they were not released, not because the respondent stopped ranking. PRD converted the author's reverse-coded 0-6 ordinals to positions (rank = 7 - value, 0 -> NA)

haas_2023_group_leader.office: full 1-3 ranking of the three members of a real-money group as ideal leader (self, another Hindu member, a Muslim member), Hindu respondents only (cov_treat: 0 neutral, 1 exclusive, 2 inclusive history). The raw file stores the two partners' reverse-coded demand scores and PRD derives the respondent's own position as the remaining rank; Muslim respondents' mirror task is not in PRD

jacoby_2014_political_values.office: full 1-7 ranking of political values, produced by sequential elimination; observational, cov_treat 0

kerver_2021_prosthesis_items.jurisdiction: Netherlands (national survey of people with major unilateral upper limb absence)
kerver_2021_prosthesis_items.office: the ten most important items regarding prosthesis use, chosen from the 79-item HealthFan diagram and then ranked 1 (most important) to 10

krupnikov_2019_issue_importance.office: six policy issues ranked by importance in a five-arm evidence-format experiment, but ONLY the inequality and health-care positions are in the released data; the other four issues are NA for every respondent because they were not released (cov_treat: 0 control, 1 human-interest story, 2 statistics as percentages, 3 statistics as counts, 4 counts with a denominator; 42 rows have no arm)

malhotra_2008_katrina_blame.office: full 1-7 ranking of officials most to blame for Hurricane Katrina, in a four-arm cue experiment (cov_treat: 0 names only, 1 office cue, 2 party cue, 3 both)

mcmurry_2022_identity_ranking.office: full 1-4 ranking of identity categories (cov_treat: 0 control, 1 identity treatment, 2 material treatment)

ojwang_2020_sweetpotato_traits.jurisdiction: Mpigi and Masaka districts, Central Uganda (sweetpotato value-chain survey)
ojwang_2020_sweetpotato_traits.office: sixteen sweetpotato traits ranked by importance, 1 = most important, by farmers, vine multipliers, traders, processors and consumers

pradel_2024_speech_types.office: full 1-4 ranking of four speech types in a five-arm experiment (cov_treat: 0 control, 1 non-group-related control, 2 uncivil, 3 intolerant, 4 threatening; cov_treatment is the label)

rathbun_2022_trait_ranking.office: nine traits, of which respondents ranked at least two, so the NAs are by design (cov_treat is the rated group, 1 individuals / 2 countries, with no control arm -- it is not 0-indexed)
